meta.title: Gîte Au fil de l'eau — Holiday rental in Storckensohn
meta.description: Gîte Au fil de l'eau in Storckensohn, a renovated former farmhouse that can host up to 10 guests, with wellness area and terrace in the heart of the High Vosges of Alsace.

hero.title: Welcome to the Gîte
hero.intro1: The Gîte Au fil de l'eau offers a peaceful setting to relax in the heart of the High Vosges of Alsace, in the small village of Storckensohn.
hero.intro2: Located in a renovated former farmhouse turned into a comfortable country home, the gîte can accommodate up to 10 guests.

wellness.text: A wellness area with spa, sauna, bathroom and loungers is accessible by lift on level -1. Its large bay windows open onto the orchard meadow along the stream.

randonnees.title: Hiking
randonnees.intro1: The village of Storckensohn is located in the heart of the Vosges mountains. A wide network of hiking trails starts directly from the village.
randonnees.intro2: Your hosts will be happy to advise you on the best routes and points of interest.
randonnees.intro3: A network of mountain lodges, fully renovated in 2013, welcomes you for meals and evening gatherings.

meta.title: Wesserling Park — Remarkable Gardens and Textile Heritage
meta.description: Discover Wesserling Park, its remarkable gardens, textile ecomuseum, the Great Boiler House, and numerous cultural and artistic events.

wesserling.title: Wesserling Park
wesserling.intro1: Located in an area with a rich textile tradition, Wesserling Park traces the extraordinary industrial history of the former Royal Manufactory.
wesserling.intro2: The park is renowned for its five magnificent gardens, listed as “Remarkable Gardens”, and for its unique collection of buildings related to the textile industry (factories, workshops, owners’ mansion, master houses, industrial wasteland, farmhouse…).
wesserling.intro3: Its Textile Ecomuseum and Great Boiler House combine the site’s history with contemporary art through interactive exhibitions, sound and light experiences…
wesserling.intro4: The park also brings textile crafts back to life with theatrical tours, spinning, weaving and block-printing demonstrations. It hosts numerous garden, textile, cultural and artistic events throughout the year.

meta.title: Storckensohn Oil Mill | Gîte Au fil de l'eau
meta.description: Discover the Storckensohn Oil Mill, a restored historic site where you can observe traditional oil and cider production techniques, all in an authentic setting in the heart of the High Vosges of Alsace.

moulin.title: The Storckensohn Oil Mill
moulin.p1: Built in 1732, the mill operated until 1962. Apples and pears were used to produce farmhouse cider. Walnuts, rapeseed, and sunflower seeds were brought in large quantities to extract a fine and flavorful oil. Eventually, the tired, inactive wheel came to a stop.
moulin.p2: Restoration of the mill began in 1991 thanks to a group of volunteers. The water of the Dorfbach, flowing proudly from the Gazon Vert, can once again power the bucket wheel patiently rebuilt to match the original. The cider press, carved from a single oak trunk two centuries ago, once again produces a high-quality juice – the much-appreciated apple must.
moulin.p3: What an emotion when everything comes back to life. The massive millstone can once again turn and crush apples, walnuts, and hazelnuts. The old wooden gears and shafts joyfully transmit the necessary energy in every direction. Walnuts and hazelnuts soften in the restored oven before being pressed by the impressive oil press, now able to develop enormous pressure. The ancestral, mysterious and captivating machinery – as if coming from the dawn of time – occasionally resumes its work in season to press rapeseed and sunflower seeds.
